newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices track NYMEX lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices track NYMEX lower.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent low sulphur diesel prices tracked futures prices lower on unchanged differentials on Friday, traders said.
Basis in the Group Three and Chicago markets was expected to reverse course and move higher next week after easing through the week on weaker differentials and lower futures prices.
"I think things will be firming up next week," one trader said.
NYMEX April heating oil was down nearly 1.0 cent a gallon in early afternoon trade and April unleaded was nearly 0.75 cents a gallon lower.
Low sulphur diesel for March deliveries was talked 6.0/6.25 cents a gallon over NYMEX April heating oil in Chicago and 3.75/4.0 cents over the print in Group Three.
The Williams Pipeline system reported a 36-day supply of low sulphur diesel and 25-day supply of unleaded on hand, traders said.
